text:
incident-bot: PAGING: multiple driver resets observed on host gpu-node-17. Symptoms: container exits, Xid flood, single-bit ECC spike. Severity: P1 potential multi-tenant degradation. Please ack and triage.
maria: acked - I'm on call. pinging eng-sre and infra. @sam @keisha pls join. Quick check: what services impacted?
sam: reported 6 model-worker pods restarted in last 8m. Router shows increased 5xx and higher p95 for streaming endpoints in us-east-2. No customer bridge yet but could be needed.
keisha: joining. pulling logs and nv-smi.
dave: telemetry -> ECC correctable events jumped from baseline ~1/hr to ~60 in last 12m on gpu-node-17. Kernel shows repeated Xid 31/43 entries.
eng-sre-bot: dmesg snippet from gpu-node-17:
```
[ 54321.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, pid=4021, gpu=0000:3b:00.0
[ 54321.123789] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 54321.124000] nvidia-modeset: GPU unregister
[ 54321.400000] kernel: NVRM: GPU reset detected
```
sam: nvidia-smi summary saved. Temp ~70C, driver 525.85, ECC volatile single-bit counts very high in last 15m. Container logs show abrupt termination on GPU ioctl failures, not cgroup OOMs.
keisha: let's isolate host and route traffic away. plan: cordon, drain non-critical, trigger router fallback pools, collect full logs and nv-host trace.
maria: executing: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17` then `kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=45`
sam: drain in flight. Evicted 6 pods, 1 stateful with local disk needed manual reschedule. Router switched ~92% of load off node. Error rate reduced but cust-eu-19 still sees elevated errors.
customer-bridge-bot: queued customer note: "We observed transient GPU host instability causing some 5xx errors. Traffic was rerouted and we're investigating. We'll update with root cause and mitigations." Approve to send? :email:
maria: send. Also opening incident ticket INF-6342 and assigning to hw-team + drivers.
dave: attempted driver restart on node (`systemctl restart nvidia-driver`) - kernel immediately logged another Xid. Soft restart didn't clear.
eng-sre-bot: collected artifacts -> /var/log/gpu-node-17/artifacts-1719510005.tar.gz (dmesg, nv-host, nvidia-smi -q, kubelet logs)
keisha: nvidia-smi -q excerpt:
```
GPU 0:
    Product Name                    : NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB
    FB Memory Usage                 : 15000 MiB / 81920 MiB
    ECC Errors
        Volatile
            Single-bit ECC Errors   : 864 (in last 15m)
            Double-bit ECC Errors   : 0
        Aggregate
            Single-bit ECC Errors   : 903
```
maria: decision: keep node cordoned, spin replacement node via autoscaler, schedule hardware diag. Vendor contact will want firmware and hw logs.
sam: starting controlled repro on spare-gpu-09 with same driver/kernel combo to attempt deterministic ECC stress. Will cap to low risk window.
dave: note - kubelet shows no OOM kills pre-reset, containers appear to die with `cudaErrorUnknown` on next gpu call. Suggests driver/kernel fault.
keisha: adding a temporary rule: if ECC single-bit increases > 40 in 10m, auto-cordon node. I'll draft alert.
maria: agreed - open RFC to update runbook and create dashboard alert. For now, mitigation = traffic reroute + host isolation.
eng-sre-bot: vendor case opened NV-9312. Vendor requested firmware dump and asked to try a hardware reseat/reboot if safe.
dave: vendor recommended capturing ECC scrub stats and enabling persistent ECC logging. Also asked for GPU-core dump if next reset produces one.
keisha: run repro on spare -> running memtest-style kernel to exercise GPU memory. Will monitor for Xid.
sam: spare-gpu-09 repro started, monitoring nv-host trace. If we reproduce same Xid quickly, increases chance of model/driver combo bug. If not, likely hardware intermittent fault.
maria: timeline note: 11:20 UTC page fired, 11:22 cordoned, 11:24 drain started, 11:28 traffic reroute, 11:50 artifacts collected, 12:05 vendor engaged. Impact: transient 5xx for ~10m for subset of tenants, mitigated by routing and autoscale.
eng-sre-bot: incident INF-6342 created, status -> active. Link to logs: https://internal-s3/redwood-incidents/INF-6342/logs.tar.gz
dave: suggestion for postmortem: correlate ECC bursts with model load pattern and job id; consider auto-evict policy after n resets within m minutes; consider kernel module param to throttle resets.
keisha: adding runbook tasks: (1) alert on ECC rate; (2) add automation to cordon on Xid > 3 in 10m; (3) test driver/firmware matrix on our A100 fleet.
maria: hw-team will perform physical diagnostics and replace GPU if vendor confirms hardware. Leaving thread open until replacement verified and postmortem drafted. Thanks all. :pray: 
eng-sre-bot: thread status updated: active -> mitigated_pending_vendor. Attachment: /incidents/INF-6342/summary.md
